summary.text: Eddie Settle is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 36 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Trevor Hardwick.
A business owner, he took office in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Settle earned an associate degree from Wilkes Community College, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner and his birthplace as North Carolina.
He took office in the Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Paul Newton.
The General Assembly's website lists his district as covering Alexander, Surry, Wilkes and Yadkin counties.
He chairs the Commerce and Insurance Committee and serves as vice chair of the Environmental Review Commission.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
